full_text_en:
Ma Zhongxuan — illegal possession of drugs

Defendant: Ma Zhongxuan, male, 29 years old, a native of Lanzhou City, Gansu Province, arrested on April 5, 1993.

The People's Procuratorate of Chengguan District, Lanzhou City, Gansu Province instituted a public prosecution in the Chengguan District People's Court against the defendant Ma Zhongxuan for the crime of illegal possession of drugs.

The Chengguan District People's Court found through public trial that: On March 23, 1993, when the defendant Ma Zhongxuan was taking drugs in a borrowed room at No. 13 Zhongshan Road, Chengguan District, Lanzhou City, he was discovered by public security officers who were checking household registrations, and 23.3 grams of heroin and 1.6 grams of opium were seized on the spot from his residence.

The above facts are confirmed by the heroin and opium seized from the residence of the defendant Ma Zhongxuan, the Criminal Science and Technology Appraisal Report of Lanzhou Public Security Bureau, and witness testimony, and Ma Zhongxuan also confessed to the facts.

The Chengguan District People's Court held that: After the defendant Ma Zhongxuan became addicted to drug abuse, he illegally purchased a relatively large quantity of heroin to satisfy his own consumption needs. The heroin stored by Ma Zhongxuan was purchased from others, and he engaged in the act of buying drugs. However, it was not for the purpose of selling, and there was no evidence to prove that he engaged in selling. Therefore, his conduct did not constitute the crime of trafficking in drugs. Ma Zhongxuan's act of storing drugs constituted the crime of illegal possession of drugs as provided in Article 3 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Prohibition of Narcotic Drugs. Accordingly, on June 5, 1993, the court rendered the following judgment:

The defendant Ma Zhongxuan is convicted of the crime of illegal possession of drugs and sentenced to six years of fixed-term imprisonment.

After the first instance judgment was pronounced, the defendant Ma Zhongxuan did not file an appeal within the appeal period.
